limitations: D is endogenous, not experimentally manipulated. The targets only appear at two fixed positions ((+-2, 1.5, -4)); D mostly comes from where the player left the crosshair after the previous peek. This is observational correlation, not a controlled Fitts design; D covaries with previous-peek overshoot/correction behavior.

MT includes reaction time and counter-strafe stop time. MT = t_firstShot - t_visible, so the regression intercept absorbs RT and stopping time. t_detect is available for only 5-9 of 20 peeks in the counter-strafe drill, too few for per-peek RT subtraction; fitts-v1 therefore applies no RT correction.
sample_limitation: Single anonymous participant P001, three sessions on one 240 Hz machine, one drill config. Not population-level evidence (KI-004 R-7).
